com.sun.xml.internal.ws.api

接口 ComponentRegistry

  • 所有超级接口:
    Component
    所有已知子接口:
    WSBindingProvider
    所有已知实现类:
    Container, DataSourceDispatch, DispatchImpl, Fiber, JAXBDispatch, MessageDispatch, PacketDispatch, SEIStub, SOAPMessageDispatch, Stub, WSEndpoint, WSEndpointImpl, WSEndpointMOMProxy, WSService, WSServiceDelegate

    public interface ComponentRegistry
extends Component
    Registry for component delegates. It is expected that implementations of ComponentRegistry will delegate to registered Components in its own implementation of Component.getSPI(java.lang.Class), either before or after it considers its own SPI implementations.
    从以下版本开始:
    2.2.6
